reasons: The inherited 21-node recipe was re-run unmodified against branch + origin/main after the rebase and returned status pass / exitCode 0 — no schema migration and no node edits were needed, so this round re-validates the merge and the review fix in one pass.

Every original AC still maps to at least one assertion node: AC1/AC2 to on-device absence/presence assertions plus a read screenshot, AC3/AC4 to assert_exit_code over the focused 'pay with token funding state' Jest block.

The review fix landed inside the AC3/AC4 coverage rather than outside it: that Jest block now reports 17 passing tests (16 inherited plus the new regression test), so the recipe's exit-code assertion now also guards the debounce-window defect.
The new regression test was proven to fail with the fix reverted, so the added coverage is a real gate and not a test that passes for the wrong reason.
better_version_guidance: Carried forward: if the runner gains a working viewport measurement for React Native host nodes, replace AC2's expected=present assertions with expected=visible so the action-button claim stops depending on a human reading the capture.
Carried forward: seed a fixed-balance fixture token so the funding message text is deterministic instead of tracking the live ETH balance.

New: the recipe's command node writes its log into the parent run's task dir (temp/tasks/fix/tat-3742-0813-171821/artifacts/). It resolved here only because that directory still exists in this checkout; a future inheritance should rewrite the path to the current TASK_DIR.

intent_clarity.reason: Node intents were inherited unchanged and still state trader-visible goals rather than restating actions or selectors; the runner's intent validator accepted the recipe as-is on re-run.

coverage.reason: All four inherited ACs re-asserted green, and this round's defect (place-order button enabled during the 300ms validation debounce after the pay-token balance resolves short) is covered by a new test inside the AC3/AC4 Jest block the recipe already asserts on.

evidence_fit.reason: The visual AC is proven by a PNG that was read directly, not judged from its filename; the hidden button-gating behaviour is proven by test exit code and a reverted-fix check, not by a screenshot.

flake_risk.reason: Unchanged from the inherited assessment: the underlying defect is a timing window and the screenshot content still varies with the live fixture token balance. This run additionally hit one mid-run mobile.runtime_recovered (HUD/CDP transient) which the runner absorbed without failing a node, and reported 15 app warning/error side findings whose relation to the task is undetermined.

contextual_findings.message: The ac3-ac4-run-funding-state-tests command node writes its log to temp/tasks/fix/tat-3742-0813-171821/artifacts/ (the parent run's dir) rather than this run's TASK_DIR. It resolved only because that directory is still present in this checkout; left untouched because step 10 forbids non-mechanical edits to a passing inherited recipe.

good_patterns: regression test verified to fail with the fix reverted
review fix covered by an assertion surface the recipe already gates on
inherited recipe re-run unmodified to validate rebase and fix together
